history.title.note: Page and document title for the run history and its run details.

history.refresh.note: Reload the current history after new records have arrived.

history.more.note: History pagination button; fetches with next_before, not a numeric offset.

history.back.note: Run-detail action that returns to the full History list.

history.loading.note: Screen-reader label while history or a run detail is loading.

history.empty.title.note: Empty history heading before any run has a record.

history.empty.body.text: Your runs will appear here. Start one from Overview when you are ready.
history.empty.body.note: Friendly empty history guidance. Overview is the page name.

history.empty.overview.note: Empty history action leading to the Overview page.

history.detail.title.note: Main heading when a particular run is open.

history.checks.day_count.note: One quiet, initially folded row per local day for all automatic check records, including single checks. count is numeric; never call checks successful runs.

history.checks.latest.note: Button that opens the newest check within a grouped day.

history.technical.title.note: Collapsed disclosure title for exact task and browser error detail, never the primary error message.

history.technical.task.note: Heading for a task's technical detail. task is the translated shared task name.

history.tasks.not_run.note: Initially folded run-detail disclosure replacing primary rows for tasks recorded as off, not_run or skip with unknown points. count is numeric. Opening it retains every task name and its recorded status; it never hides a known point value or a failed task.

forms.one: Started {count} minute late because a full-screen app or presentation was open.
forms.other: Started {count} minutes late because a full-screen app or presentation was open.

history.deferred.waited.note: Run-detail delay notice after a full-screen app or presentation ended. count is the numeric minutes waited, rounded up from deferred.waited_s. A delay is not a run failure.

history.deferred.gave_up.text: A full-screen app or presentation was still open after 40 minutes, so the run started anyway.
history.deferred.gave_up.note: Run-detail delay notice when deferred.gave_up is true. The scheduled run waited at most 40 minutes and then proceeded. Do not imply a failure or blame the user.

history.day.today.note: Above the date in History's date list and beside the day heading, for the current local day

history.day.yesterday.note: Above the date in History's date list and beside the day heading, for the previous local day

history.mark.app_run.note: On a run he started from the app, trigger app, and on its day in the date list; it does not say which button

history.mark.waited.note: On a run that waited for a full-screen app or presentation; minutes is numeric, the wait rounded up from deferred.waited_s, 40 when it gave up; translators may use the locale's short form for minutes

history.mark.attention.note: On a day in the date list and on a folded check group or run, when a record failed, was partial or interrupted, could not read the Rewards page or found the account signed out

history.sources.title.note: Heading over a run's band and tiles; they cover only the points the tasks brought

history.tasks.no_points.note: Folded disclosure in a History run block, under the task tiles, for the tasks that brought no points in this run: done with 0 points, skipped, off or not run. Opening it lists each task with its status and, when known, its points. count is numeric.
